observations: Photo 0: A blue smartphone held in hand, screen showing Settings menu. Storage section visible: '12% used - 113 GB free'. Battery at 22%. 'About phone' option visible at bottom. Watermark 'DEETECH GADGETZ' and 'POSTED ON JIJI'.
Photo 1: Back of the same blue phone, showing dual-camera module, Google 'G' logo, and a pink sticky note with handwritten text: 'Pixel 8a 128GB'. Watermark same as above.
Photo 2: Front of the phone, screen showing lock screen with time '18:28', date 'Sat, 10 Sept', and setup prompt 'Finish setting up your device'. Watermark same as above.
All photos show a consistent blue phone with rounded corners and a centered punch-hole camera. The design matches Google Pixel 8a.

read_from: photo 0 'About phone' section (implied by UI and storage size)

claims.evidence: Photo 1 shows a pink sticky note with 'Pixel 8a 128GB' written on it. Photo 0 shows 113 GB free, consistent with 128 GB total storage.
No SIM tray, settings menu, or carrier lock status visible. The phone is in setup mode (photo 2), which does not confirm unlock status.

risks.risk: Phone may be locked to a carrier or have a network lock
risks.proof: Photo of the phone's settings > 'Network & internet' > 'SIM card' or 'About phone' > 'Status' showing carrier lock status, or a video showing SIM insertion and network selection.
risks.if_unproven: priced as potentially locked, which reduces value significantly in Lagos market

risks.risk: Sticky note may be fake or added by seller to misrepresent model
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the back of the phone without the sticky note, showing the model name engraved or printed on the device (if any), or a photo of the 'About phone' screen showing model name.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unverified model, which could be a lower-tier Pixel or counterfeit

risks.risk: Phone may have physical damage not visible in photos (e.g., cracked screen, water damage, bent frame)
risks.proof: Video or photo showing the phone from all angles, including edges, ports, and screen under different lighting, and a close-up of the screen for dead pixels or cracks.
risks.if_unproven: priced as potentially damaged, which reduces value

proof_requests: Photo of the 'About phone' screen showing model name and storage capacity.
Photo of the 'Network & internet' settings showing carrier lock status.
Video showing the phone being turned on, unlocking, and connecting to a network with a SIM card.
Close-up photo of the phone's back without the sticky note to verify model engraving.
response.reason: While the model and storage are supported by the sticky note and storage info, the 'factory unlocked' claim is unverifiable from current photos. There is also risk of the sticky note being fake or the phone having hidden damage. Proof of model and unlock status is needed before pricing.
